<thought>Based on the ¹H NMR data, the compound shows a para‑disubstituted benzene (two sets of 2 H aromatic signals), a methoxy singlet (OCH₃), and an aliphatic fragment CH₃–CH₂–CH– attached to a heteroatom (the CH appears at 3.09 ppm, indicating it is bound to oxygen). The most parsimonious structure that fits all these features is **p‑methoxy‑phenyl‑propyl ether**, i.e., a para‑methoxy phenyl group bearing an O‑CH(CH₃)CH₂‑ substituent. The SMILES for this molecule is:**

<final_answer>COc1ccc(OCC(C)H)cc1</final_answer>
